description: Server cache + URL state + client store + local state, each holding only the state that matches its strengths.
Using URL params as query key parts, so navigation, reloads and shared links map directly to cache entries.
`setSearchParams((params) => ...)` updates one param while keeping the others; delete defaults to keep URLs clean.
`key={q}` remounts a local draft when the committed URL value changes elsewhere, avoiding sync effects.
A client store copies server data only at a user's explicit action (adding to cart) and only the fields it needs.
